title: Add and subtract to 20
summary: Add, take away and find missing numbers within 20.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 finds a missing start after more come. Q2 is two steps, add then take away. Q3 compares two amounts. Q4 solves 7 = ? − 9. Q5 balances 8 + 5 = 10 + ?. Q6 finds a missing start after a give-away. Q7 adds 9 and 9. Q8 picks the sum for a take-away story. Q9 finds how many were taken from 20. Q10 finds how many Ben has when he has 3 more than Mia. No hints.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses small pictured stories and one balanced sum. Medium adds zero, crossing ten and matching both sides. Hard adds a new kind of thinking: missing starts, two-step stories and compare differences.

questions.prompt: Ben has some cars. 4 more come. Now he has 11. How many cars did he start with?
questions.explanation: 7 and 4 make 11. The starting group has 7 cars.

narration.prompt: Ben has some cars. Four more come. Now he has eleven. How many cars did he start with?

questions.prompt: Mia has 6 ducks. She gets 2 more. How many ducks does she have now?
questions.explanation: 6 and 2 more make 8. The extra ducks are added to the starting group.

narration.prompt: Mia has 6 ducks. She gets 2 more. How many ducks does she have now?

questions.prompt: Mia has 14 stars. Ben has 9 stars. How many more stars does Mia have?
questions.explanation: 14 take away 9 is 5. Adding the two groups is not how many more.

narration.prompt: Mia has fourteen stars. Ben has nine stars. How many more stars does Mia have?

questions.explanation: 16 take away 9 is 7. 9 take away 7 is the other way round.

narration.prompt: Which number is missing? seven equals what take away nine?

questions.prompt: 8 plus 5 is the same as 10 plus what?

narration.prompt: Eight plus five is the same as ten plus what?

questions.prompt: Sam had some apples. He gave 6 away. Now he has 9. How many did he start with?
questions.explanation: 15 take away 6 is 9. The starting group has 15 apples.

narration.prompt: Sam had some apples. He gave six away. Now he has nine. How many did he start with?

questions.explanation: 9 and 9 make 18. Taking 9 from 9 would leave 0.

questions.prompt: Ben has 17 frogs and gives away 9. Which sum shows this?
questions.explanation: He gives some away, so take away. 17 take away 9 is 8.

narration.prompt: Ben has seventeen frogs and gives away nine. Which sum shows this?

questions.explanation: 20 take away 12 is 8. Adding 20 and 8 is the wrong job.

narration.prompt: Which number is missing? twenty take away what equals eight?

questions.prompt: Mia has 8 bananas. Ben has 3 more than Mia. How many bananas does Ben have?
questions.explanation: 8 and 3 more make 11. Taking 3 from 8 is how many fewer.

narration.prompt: Mia has eight bananas. Ben has three more than Mia. How many bananas does Ben have?
